config.mineqtt.title: MineQTT Configuration
mineqtt.configuration.title: MineQTT Configuration
config.mineqtt.broker.tooltip: MQTT broker URI, e.g. localhost, broker.lan:1883, tcp://host:1883, mqtts://host:8883 or wss://host/mqtt. Empty disables MQTT.
config.mineqtt.protocol.tooltip: 5, or 3.1.1 for brokers without MQTT 5 support
config.mineqtt.keep_alive_sec.tooltip: MQTT keep alive interval, 0 disables it
config.mineqtt.password.tooltip: Password for MQTT broker authentication. The environment variable MINEQTT_PASSWORD takes precedence, so the password need not be stored in the config file.
config.mineqtt.password.environment: The password comes from the environment variable MINEQTT_PASSWORD; this field is not used.
config.mineqtt.tls_ca_file.tooltip: PEM file with the CA certificates to trust instead of the Java truststore. Empty uses the Java truststore.
Accept any server certificate and host name. Only for testing; logged as a warning on every connect.
config.mineqtt.bridge_id.tooltip: This server's topic level under the base topic, and the MQTT client id mineqtt_<bridge id>. Empty generates one per world.
config.mineqtt.base_topic.tooltip: MQTT base topic of every MineQTT device topic
config.mineqtt.ha_birth_topic.tooltip: When Home Assistant publishes online here, MineQTT republishes discovery and state
config.mineqtt.ha_expose.tooltip: All, Opt-in (only devices a permitted player exposes), None, or Auto (All on integrated servers, Opt-in on dedicated servers)
config.mineqtt.acl_raw_allow.tooltip: Topic filters players may publish raw messages to and link raw topics under. <base> and <bridgeId> stand for the base topic and the bridge id.
Whether operators may use topics outside the allowlist. Auto: yes on integrated servers, no on dedicated servers.
Let players with the mineqtt.admin permission listen on the whole broker in the topic explorer
config.mineqtt.block_placer_enabled.tool: Allow the Block Placer to place blocks from MQTT messages
config.mineqtt.limits_max_devices_per_pl: Maximum number of MQTT devices a player may own, 0 for unlimited. A player who owns as many cannot place or claim another; operators are not limited
config.mineqtt.limits_max_wires_per_play: Maximum number of wires (Configurator links) a player may own, 0 for unlimited. Wires made from the console count for nobody
config.mineqtt.server_keep_ticking_when_: Dedicated servers only. Keep ticking with nobody online, overriding pause-when-empty-seconds in server.properties, so repeaters, pistons and light keep running. Off, MQTT is still handled while the server is paused.
config.mineqtt.error.topic: Not a valid topic: no wildcards, no leading $, no empty levels
config.mineqtt.error.bridge_id: Use 1-64 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, or leave it empty
mineqtt.device.general.name: Name
mineqtt.device.general.read_only: You may not configure this device
mineqtt.device.general.slug.preview: After saving; a number is added when another device has this slug
mineqtt.device.general.copy.tooltip: Copy the state topic to the clipboard
mineqtt.device.general.group.tooltip: Join, leave, create or rename its group
mineqtt.device.group.name: Group name
mineqtt.device.group.rename.tooltip: Rename the group (Enter); its topics follow the name
mineqtt.device.group.create.tooltip: Make a new group with this device (Enter)
mineqtt.device.group.not_managed: Only a player who may configure every device of the group may change it
mineqtt.device.group.leave.tooltip: Take this device out of the group; a group without devices is removed
mineqtt.device.group.members.tooltip: Home Assistant: shown discovers each member as a device of its own beside the group, hidden only the group
mineqtt.device.group.join.tooltip: The groups of this device's type whose every device you may configure
mineqtt.device.group.explain: A group's devices share one state and are one device in Home Assistant.
mineqtt.device.group.join.header.capped: Groups to join: %s, the first %s here
mineqtt.device.group.join.empty: No group to join. Name a new one on the group page, or use the Configurator's Group mode.
mineqtt.device.group.join.row.tooltip: Join this group; the device takes over its state
mineqtt.device.general.expose.tooltip: Home Assistant: on discovers the device, off hides it, default follows the server's ha.expose
mineqtt.device.general.expose.denied: Exposing devices to Home Assistant needs operator rights or mineqtt:ha.expose
mineqtt.device.general.discovery.tooltip: Whether Home Assistant discovers this device now
mineqtt.device.controls.no_use: You may not use this device
mineqtt.device.control.filter.tooltip: Which mobs it counts while it detects mobs: their ids, such as zombie, pig or minecraft:cow, at most 8. Empty counts every mob.
mineqtt.device.advanced.mode.channel.too: Channel: an item or paper name. The server picks the topic for the owner: the name as written where its allowlist covers it, else under mineqtt/shared/. Click for a private channel.
mineqtt.device.advanced.mode.private.too: Private: an item or paper name in the owner's own subtree, raw/players/<owner>/, which only the owner's devices use (v1's private mode). Click for a typed topic.
mineqtt.device.advanced.mode.topic.toolt: Topic: used exactly as typed, if the server's allowlist lets both you and the owner use it. Click for a channel.
mineqtt.device.advanced.save.tooltip: Save the changed fields (Enter saves the one you type in). An empty channel or topic removes the Raw Link.
mineqtt.device.advanced.none: No Raw Link yet: type a channel or a topic above
mineqtt.device.advanced.no_raw_link: This device has no Raw Link
mineqtt.device.advanced.needs_link: Give it a channel or a topic first
mineqtt.device.advanced.retain.tooltip: Publish the level retained, so receivers that start later still get it. This device's default: %s
mineqtt.device.advanced.retain.toggle: A toggle payload is never retained: it carries no level
mineqtt.device.advanced.retain.rising: Sends its on payload on rising edges only, as the Static Publisher it was converted from did: an event is never retained
mineqtt.device.advanced.links.tooltip: The wires from and to this device, made with the Configurator's Link mode
mineqtt.device.links.empty: No links yet. With the Configurator in Link mode, click this device, then the device it drives (or the other way round).
mineqtt.device.links.row.via_group:
%s
Through group %s, which this device is in
mineqtt.device.access.claim.tooltip: Become this device's owner; then you decide who has access
mineqtt.device.access.mode.tooltip: Steps through private, claim and public. The owner and operators always may use and configure the device.
mineqtt.device.access.denied: Only the owner or an operator may change who has access
mineqtt.device.access.mode.private.meani: Only the owner and operators may use or configure it.
mineqtt.device.access.mode.claim.meaning: Players the claim here trusts may use and configure it.
mineqtt.device.access.mode.public.meanin: Anyone may use it; players the claim trusts configure it.
mineqtt.device.access.claim_mod: Flan decides whom the claim here trusts: interacting to use, opening containers to configure.
mineqtt.device.access.no_claim_mod: No claim mod is installed, so the claim here trusts every player.
mineqtt.device.diagnostics.eject.tooltip: Gives you the %s items its old configuration slots held: topic papers and items, payload papers, spawn eggs. Breaking the block drops them too.
mineqtt.device.eject.done: Took %s items from the device's old slots
mineqtt.device.diagnostics.retry.tooltip: Attach the device again, as /mineqtt devices retry does
mineqtt.device.diagnostics.copy.tooltip: Copy the device's UUID to the clipboard
mineqtt.device.diagnostics.payload.hidde: Only players who may configure the device see payloads
mineqtt.device.diagnostics.counts.toolti: MQTT messages since the server started: received on its topics, of those dropped (no command, or refused), and published. The whole bridge dropped %s inbound messages (a full queue, a payload too large) and %s outbound (no broker to wait for).
mineqtt.console.not_running: MineQTT is not running on this server
mineqtt.console.bridge.home_assistant.to: Home Assistant: ha.expose %s, %s devices and groups discovered
mineqtt.console.bridge.dropped.tooltip: Messages the bridge dropped since the server started. Waiting now: %s inbound, %s in the outbox
mineqtt.console.bridge.wires.tooltip: Since the server started, the wires delivered %s messages and dropped %s; /mineqtt status names the reasons
mineqtt.console.server.integrated.toolti: A singleplayer or LAN world: it pauses only with the game menu
mineqtt.console.server.ticking.tooltip: It pauses %s s after the last player leaves; MQTT is then handled between ticks
mineqtt.console.server.paused.tooltip: Nobody was online for %s s, so the server paused: MQTT is handled between ticks; repeaters, pistons and light wait until it resumes
mineqtt.console.action.reconnect.tooltip: Build the broker connection again from the config (/mineqtt reconnect)
mineqtt.console.action.republish.tooltip: Publish Home Assistant discovery, availability and state of everything again (/mineqtt discovery republish)
mineqtt.console.action.prune.tooltip: Forget the devices whose block is gone from a loaded chunk (/mineqtt devices prune)
mineqtt.console.devices.empty.all: No devices are registered on this bridge.
mineqtt.console.devices.empty.own: There is no device here you may configure.
mineqtt.console.groups.empty.all: No groups are on this bridge.
mineqtt.console.groups.empty.own: There is no group whose every device you may configure.
mineqtt.console.groups.row.tooltip:

mineqtt.block_sensor.mode.name: Display name
mineqtt.block_sensor.mode.full_data.tool: ID, name, state properties, position, dimension and block entity data.
mineqtt.block_sensor.mode.block_id.toolt: Registry name only, for example minecraft:stone.
mineqtt.block_sensor.mode.name.tooltip: Display name only, for example Stone (server language).
mineqtt.block_sensor.mode.properties.too: Block state properties only, for example {"facing":"north","powered":"true"}.
mineqtt.block_emitter.test_tooltip: Apply this payload to the target block immediately
mineqtt.block_emitter.test_ops_only: Only operators may test the Block Emitter.
mineqtt.configurator.link.hint: Link mode: click the device that drives, then the device it drives
mineqtt.configurator.link.source: Linking from %s: click the device it drives, or %1$s again to stop
mineqtt.configurator.link.gone: The device you linked from is gone
mineqtt.configurator.link.no_outputs: %s has nothing to drive another device with
mineqtt.configurator.group.hint: Group mode: click a device, then the devices to put into its group

mineqtt.configurator.group.gone: The device you grouped with is gone
mineqtt.configurator.group.not_groupable: %s cannot be grouped: only actuators such as lamps and outputs can
mineqtt.configurator.group.other_type: %s is not of the type of %s: a group holds devices of one type
mineqtt.configurator.copy_paste.hint: Copy-Paste mode: click a device to copy its settings, then devices of its type to paste them onto
mineqtt.configurator.copy_paste.copied: Copied %s: click devices of its type to paste, or %1$s again to stop
mineqtt.configurator.copy_paste.other_ty: %s is not of the type of %s
mineqtt.group_name.title: Group %s and %s
mineqtt.link_picker.title: Link %s → %s
mineqtt.link_picker.wired.tooltip:

Linked already: pick it to unlink
mineqtt.link_picker.mapping.follow.toolt: The target takes the source's value
mineqtt.link_picker.mapping.invert.toolt: The target takes the opposite: on is off, level n is 15 - n
mineqtt.link_picker.mapping.pulse_toggle: Each event, or each time the source turns on, toggles the target
mineqtt.link_picker.unlink.tooltip: Removes the link between these ports
mineqtt.configurator.protected: %s is protected here (spawn protection or the world border)
mineqtt.raw_link.moved: Raw Link of %s moved from %s to %s, because this server refuses the old topic for its owner.
mineqtt.raw_link.resolved: Raw Link of %s moved from %s to %s: its item or paper topic resolves there for its owner now.

mineqtt.block_emitter.disabled: The Block Emitter is disabled on this server: it places no blocks until an admin sets blockPlacer.enabled in the MineQTT config.
mineqtt.cron_timer.fields: Format: minute hour dayOfMonth month weekday
mineqtt.alarm_clock.no_alarms: No alarm configured. Set a time and click Apply.
mineqtt.retired.tooltip: Retired in MineQTT 2 – break to recover parts
mineqtt.retired.use: %s was retired in MineQTT 2 and does nothing any more. %s. Break it to get a Network Chip and the items it held back.
mineqtt.retired.dynamic_publisher: Players online: MineQTT Bridge device; the rest has no replacement
mineqtt.retired.topic_relay: Route topics in Home Assistant, Node-RED or a broker bridge
